name: Wild Ones Western New York Chapter
mission: Volunteer chapter promoting native landscaping in Western New York; publishes an annual native plant shopping guide and a list of native-focused nurseries.

name: Wild Ones Habitat Gardening in Central New York Chapter
mission: Central New York Wild Ones chapter; runs spring and fall native plant sales and maintains a regional list of native plant sales.

name: Finger Lakes Native Plant Society
mission: Founded 1997; promotes appreciation of the region's native flora through field trips, programs, a members' seed exchange, and native plant sales.
membership: Membership includes the Solidago newsletter and access to the seed exchange.

name: Monroe County Soil & Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district; runs the annual Conservation Tree & Shrub Program, erosion control and habitat assistance.
sources: Monroe County SWCD — Tree & Shrub Program

name: Erie County Soil and Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district; annual sale and distribution of evergreen and deciduous seedlings and transplants for conservation of natural resources.

name: Ontario County Soil and Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district serving Ontario County; annual tree and shrub seedling sale.

name: Livingston County Soil and Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district serving Livingston County; annual tree and shrub seedling sale.
sources: Genesee Valley Conservancy — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sales

name: Genesee Valley Conservancy
mission: Land trust protecting farmland and natural areas in the Genesee Valley; publishes a roundup of regional conservation district seedling sales.
sources: Genesee Valley Conservancy — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sales

name: Genesee Land Trust
mission: Rochester-area land trust; protects natural areas and hosts native plant sales and habitat events.

name: Cornell Botanic Gardens
mission: Cornell University's botanic gardens and natural areas; hosts a spring native plant sale in partnership with the Finger Lakes Native Plant Society and houses FLNPS meetings at the Nevin Center.
sources: Cornell Events — Spring Native Plant Sale 2026

name: Cornell Cooperative Extension — Tompkins County
mission: Extension office; publishes native plant gardening guidance and a directory of local nurseries and garden centers.

name: Healthy Yards Monroe County
mission: Monroe County initiative promoting pesticide-free, native-planted yards; maintains a directory of local native plant sellers.
sources: Healthy Yards Monroe County — Native Plant Sellers

name: Buffalo Niagara Waterkeeper
mission: Water quality and habitat restoration across the Niagara River watershed; publishes a Western New York native plant supplier guide.

name: WNY PRISM (Partnership for Regional Invasive Species Management)
mission: Regional invasive species partnership hosted at SUNY Buffalo State; distributes native plant supplier lists as an alternative to invasive ornamentals.
sources: WNY PRISM — Native Plants Supplier List (PDF)

name: Color Brighton Green
mission: Brighton, NY environmental group; launched an annual native plant sale featuring multiple seed-raised native growers.
sources: Wild Ones HGCNY — Native Plant Sales

name: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library
mission: Public library system; operates a free Seed Library at the downtown Central Library Launch Pad, including native species.
sources: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library — Seed Library

name: Broome County Soil and Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district; runs a Tree & Shrub Seedling Program alongside erosion and water quality work.

name: Tioga County Soil and Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district; annual tree and shrub seedling sale and landowner reforestation assistance.

name: Schuyler County Soil and Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district; the Green Arbor Program has supplied over 750,000 low-cost trees and shrubs for conservation plantings.

name: Steuben County Soil & Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district; runs a tree nursery program for landowners.
sources: Steuben County SWCD — Tree Nursery Program

name: Chemung County Soil and Water Conservation District
mission: County conservation district; annual tree program selling bundles of young trees, shrubs, flowers and other native plants.
sources: Chemung County SWCD holds tree sale (WETM)

name: Chemung Valley Audubon Society
mission: All-volunteer Audubon chapter in the Southern Tier; bird monitoring, habitat restoration with native grasses and forbs, and native plant education. Does not run a plant sale.
notes: Organization only — no plants or seed supplied, so it has no vendor row.

name: Pollinator Partnership
mission: Pollinator conservation nonprofit; publishes and maintains the Native Plant Nurseries and Local Seed Vendors list for New York State, with a per-vendor capability checklist.
sources: Pollinator Partnership — Native Plant Nurseries & Seed Vendors for New York State (June 2024)

name: Broome County Public Library
mission: Public library in Binghamton; runs a free seed library, restarted after a pandemic pause (originally 2017).
sources: Broome County Public Library — Our Seed Library is Back

name: Southeast Steuben County Library
mission: Public library in Corning; runs a free seed library of flower, fruit and vegetable seed.
sources: Southeast Steuben County Library — Seed Library

name: Tompkins County Public Library
mission: Public library in Ithaca; hosts the Salutations Seed Library with the Master Gardeners of Tompkins County and Cornell Climate Stewards.

name: Chemung County Library District
mission: Library district serving Chemung County; Steele Memorial Library in Elmira participates in the library system's seed lending program.
sources: Chemung County Library District — Library of Things
